enum.name: CUSTOM_DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY
enum.description: Dog ability categories (bitmask). Each bit indicates whether the dog has a capability.

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_ACTION_CONTROL
entry.description: Has action control. Query detail for supported actions (CUSTOM_DOG_ACTION_OP).

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_SEARCH_LIGHT
entry.description: Has controllable search lights. Query detail for count and which lights (CUSTOM_DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_OP).

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_AUTHORITY
entry.description: Has authority control. Query detail for supported operations (CUSTOM_DOG_AUTHORITY_OP).

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_GAIT_SWITCH
entry.description: Has gait switching. Query detail for supported gait types (CUSTOM_DOG_GAIT_TYPE).

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_USAGE_MODE_SWITCH
entry.description: Has usage mode switching. Query detail for supported modes (CUSTOM_DOG_USAGE_MODE). Mode names are defined per dog model at the application layer.

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_CAMERA_SWITCH
entry.description: Has camera switching. Query detail for count (number of cameras).

entry.name: DOG_ABILITY_CATEGORY_BATTERY
entry.description: Has multi-battery reporting. Query detail for count (number of batteries). Telemetry; not a control target.

enum.name: CUSTOM_DOG_ACTION_OP
enum.description: Action operation sub-options (bitmask). Used in CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ACTION and detail/control for ACTION.

enum.name: CUSTOM_DOG_USAGE_MODE
enum.description: Usage mode sub-options (bitmask). Index semantics are model-specific.

enum.name: CUSTOM_DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_OP
enum.description: Search light sub-options (bitmask). count field in detail = total lights.

entry.name: DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_1
entry.description: Front search light is independently controllable.

entry.name: DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_2
entry.description: Rear search light is independently controllable.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_SELECT_MODEL
entry.description: Select dog model. Server loads model config; result via COMMAND_ACK.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_ABILITY_CATEGORY
entry.description: Query supported ability categories; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_SUPPORTED_ABILITY_CATEGORY (51851).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ACTION
entry.description: Request current available action sub-options; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ACTION (51852). Message 51852 may also be sent proactively when action availability changes.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_ACTION_ABILITY_DETAIL
entry.description: Query total supported actions (static capability); server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_ACTION_ABILITY_DETAIL (51855).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CAMERA_ABILITY_DETAIL
entry.description: Query camera ability details; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CAMERA_ABILITY_DETAIL (51857).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_SEARCH_LIGHT_ABILITY_DETAIL
entry.description: Query search light ability details; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_ABILITY_DETAIL (51856).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_GAIT_ABILITY_DETAIL
entry.description: Query gait ability details; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_GAIT_ABILITY_DETAIL (51858).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_USAGE_MODE_ABILITY_DETAIL
entry.description: Query usage mode ability details; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_USAGE_MODE_ABILITY_DETAIL (51859).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_AUTHORITY_ABILITY_DETAIL
entry.description: Query authority/control capability details; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_AUTHORITY_ABILITY_DETAIL (51860).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_GAIT
entry.description: Query current gait type; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_GAIT (51861).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_USAGE_MODE
entry.description: Query current usage mode; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_USAGE_MODE (51862).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_SEARCH_LIGHT_STATE
entry.description: Query current search light state; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_SEARCH_LIGHT_STATE (51863).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_CAMERA
entry.description: Query current camera; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_CAMERA (51864).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_AUTHORITY
entry.description: Query current authority state; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_AUTHORITY (51865).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_ALL_CURRENT_STATE
entry.description: Query snapshot of all current states; server sends message CUSTOM_DOG_ALL_CURRENT_STATE (51866).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_USER_COMMAND
entry.description: Send a user-defined command. Semantics of the command code are defined at the application layer.

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_JOY_DATA
message.description: Custom dog joystick channel values. Client sends; server handles.

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_SUPPORTED_ABILITY_CATEGORY
message.description: Supported ability categories (static capability). Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_ABILITY_CATEGORY (51952).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ACTION
message.description: Real-time available action sub-options (body/action state). Field is bitmask of CUSTOM_DOG_ACTION_OP. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ACTION (51953), or proactively when availability changes. Client should register a handler for id 51852.

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_BATTERY_LEVEL
message.description: Battery levels. Server may send periodically or on change. Single-battery dogs: use battery_level_1; set battery_level_2 to 0 or a documented sentinel if unused.
message.field: Battery 1 level (unit defined by implementation, e.g. percent or mV).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_ACTION_ABILITY_DETAIL
message.description: Total supported actions (static capability). Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_ACTION_ABILITY_DETAIL (51955).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_ABILITY_DETAIL
message.description: Search light ability details. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_SEARCH_LIGHT_ABILITY_DETAIL (51957).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CAMERA_ABILITY_DETAIL
message.description: Camera ability details. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CAMERA_ABILITY_DETAIL (51956).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_GAIT_ABILITY_DETAIL
message.description: Gait ability details. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_GAIT_ABILITY_DETAIL (51958).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_USAGE_MODE_ABILITY_DETAIL
message.description: Usage mode ability details. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_USAGE_MODE_ABILITY_DETAIL (51959).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_AUTHORITY_ABILITY_DETAIL
message.description: Authority/control capability details. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_AUTHORITY_ABILITY_DETAIL (51960).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_GAIT
message.description: Current gait type. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_GAIT (51968).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_USAGE_MODE
message.description: Current usage mode. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_USAGE_MODE (51969).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_SEARCH_LIGHT_STATE
message.description: Current search light state. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_SEARCH_LIGHT_STATE (51970).
message.field: Active search light type (value from CUSTOM_DOG_SEARCH_LIGHT_OP).
1 if the light is on, 0 if off.

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_CAMERA
message.description: Current camera. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_CAMERA (51971).
message.field: Current camera type (1-based index or camera type value).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_CURRENT_AUTHORITY
message.description: Current authority state. Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_CURRENT_AUTHORITY (51972).

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_ALL_CURRENT_STATE
message.description: Snapshot of current states (excluding search light and battery — those have dedicated APIs). Sent in response to COMMAND_LONG MAV_CMD_CUSTOM_DOG_GET_ALL_CURRENT_STATE (51973), or published by server proactively.

message.name: CUSTOM_DOG_ERROR_CODE
message.description: Error code. Published by server when an error occurs. No associated MAV_CMD; this is a publish/subscribe message. The meaning of each code is defined at the application layer.
